hoovering.alt: Close up, a peach Terrikin picks up a berry, drops it straight behind itself and goes for the next, over and over.

clover-gen0.alt: Generation 0, no practice: a peach Terrikin moves at random, turns grey and stops. It starved after 1 minute 11.

clover-gen1.alt: Generation 1, 23 hours of practice: the Terrikin finds berries, then wanders off along the hedge and loses track of them.

clover-gen2.alt: Generation 2, 46 hours of practice: sped up, the Terrikin goes berry to berry and survives all 3 minutes, 49 berries.

clover-final.alt: Generation 13, the 0.2 brain after 11.6 days of practice: the Terrikin heads for each berry it sees. It never starved in 64 tests.

hoovering-overview.alt: The whole garden at four times speed: three colonies sweep the lawn, leaving dropped berries everywhere and nothing at their nests.

nights-piles.alt: Sped up: three colonies with jelly piling up in their nests, while Terrikins starve right beside it.

nights-first.alt: Night falls on the first night brain. The Terrikins stay out in the dark and all 18 of them freeze.

nights-now.alt: The RL-only brain after the automated forks: at dusk every Terrikin heads home, they huddle on the nest and spin all night, and at first light they head out again.

colonies-timelapse.alt: The 0.3 brain's whole six minutes at 15 times speed: three days and three nights. By day the colonies spread out to forage, at dusk they crowd onto their nests, and new Terrikins hatch in the dark. They start as 18 and end as 19.

colonies-hatch.alt: Sped up, two eggs sit on a purple colony's nest while its Terrikins come and go. Back at normal speed, an egg cracks and a small Terrikin comes out and grows to full size.

colonies-flower.alt: A rainbow nectar flower opens on the lawn among a crowd of Terrikins. One sprints at it, kicking up a trail of dust, and eats it whole, in slow motion at the end.

colonies-turbo.alt: Turbo mode: the Terrikin that ate the flower runs off sparkling, faster than the others, its face toward the camera, then on past its nest.

colonies-starve.alt: Just after the third dawn, a purple Terrikin out on the lawn slows, greys and starves, and a small tombstone is left where it fell.

nursery-tag.alt: Five baby Terrikins play tag among wooden blocks. The one who's it glows yellow underneath; one sprints, kicking up dust.

nursery-blindspot.alt: The it's view drawn as a pale fan in front of it. A runner tucks in close behind, out of the fan, and the two go round in a tight circle.

nursery-ears.alt: The same game with hearing on: the it turns to a runner behind it and tags it.

nursery-seek.alt: Hide-and-seek: after the count, a seeker heads round the walls straight to a hider.

nursery-peek.alt: Peekaboo: a berry shows for a moment and vanishes, the baby is spun round, then turns back and goes straight to where the berry was.

nursery-tagbacks.alt: Two babies stand touching and pass being it back and forth every two seconds, while the others wander.

nursery-wall.alt: A baby parked in a corner, face against the hedge, eating each berry as it appears at its nose.

nursery-lap.alt: A baby runs a fixed lap of the arena at full speed and runs into each hidden berry along the way.

nursery-tidy.alt: A baby Terrikin beside its nest picks up a dropping, sets it down a little further out, and picks it up again until it's past the dashed line.
